name: Business in Auberdine
objectiveText: Check on Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore . Borgus mentioned a boat on the southern-most dock in Stormwind Harbor that can take you there.   Take the boat to Auberdine and find Gorbold Steelhand.  ( 1 )

objectiveRows.text: Take the boat to Auberdine and find Gorbold Steelhand.

comments.body:
Breadcrumb to have you visit Auberdine.

Unlike other breadcrumb quests, gives 0 XP. Kind of odd and possibly an oversight. But can be skipped with no consequence.

This is a new breadcrumb quest giving you information on how to travel to Auberdine from Stormwind. It grants [b]0 XP, reputation or silver[/b], and you can start [quest=982] without completing this one. You may abandon this one and go straight to [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=6301/gorbold-steelhand#map]Gorbold[/url] if you plan on doing his quest to keep your quest log clean.
